title: "Clinical background"
format: html
---

Among invasive fungal infections in organ transplant recipients, cryptococcosis ranks third in frequency [@baddley2019ast], and it carries substantial mortality [@yoon2022antibody].

Two kinds of antibody are relevant to *Cryptococcus neoformans*:

-   **Glucuronoxylomannan (GXM)-binding antibodies** recognize the main component of the fungal polysaccharide capsule [@zaragoza2009capsule].
-   **Laminarin (Lam)-binding antibodies** recognize laminarin, a β-glucan from the brown alga *Laminaria digitata* that stands in for the β-(1-3)-glucan of the fungal cell wall [@torosantucci2005lam].

Both have been linked to cryptococcosis, or to the risk of developing it, in people with HIV [@subramaniam2005uganda; @hlupeni2018crag; @yoon2019ciris] and without HIV [@rohatgi2017hivneg]. In transplant recipients, Jalali et al. found pretransplant GXM-IgM lower, but posttransplant GXM-IgM and IgG higher, in patients who developed cryptococcosis [@jalali2006gxm]. This study measured both antibodies, together with total (non-specific) IgM, IgG1 and IgG2, in transplant recipients with and without a history of posttransplant cryptococcosis [@yoon2022antibody].

## Study design in brief

-   **Setting:** University of Alabama at Birmingham; recruitment 1 January 2013 to 31 December 2018.
-   **Cases:** organ transplant recipients with a history of posttransplant cryptococcosis, diagnosed from a positive cryptococcal antigen (CrAg) result or a positive body-fluid culture.
-   **Controls:** organ transplant recipients with no such history.
-   **Measurements:** serum total IgM, IgG1 and IgG2 (µg/mL, Luminex); GXM- and Lam-binding IgM and IgG (titers); serum CrAg by lateral flow assay.
-   **Approvals:** the UAB Institutional Review Board approved the study and all participants gave written informed consent; the samples were analyzed at Albert Einstein College of Medicine under a protocol approved by its IRB.

See [`analysis-plan.md`](https://github.com/VagishHemmige/Pirofski-cryptococcus-study/blob/master/analysis-plan.md) for the full specification.
